headline: The stairwell light times itself out.
body: Someone's shoes were on the landing and are gone. The window opposite has gone dark since the last note. We keep the lamp and do not turn the page.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: black, a few pins, no weather

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: empty except a fox at the bins

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: one lamp, the stairwell already out
